चोल चोल, अस्, ई, m. f. a short jacket, a
bodice; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people in southern
India on the Coromandel coast, in the province now
called Tāñjora; (अस्), m. a prince of the Colas; the
ancestor of this people is also called Cola and was
a son of Ā-krīḍa; (अम्), n. clothes, a garment.
—चोलोण्डुक (˚ल-उण्˚), अस्, m. a diadem, a fillet
for the head, a turban or tiara.

चोलक, अस्, m. a breastplate, a cuirass; N. of a
people, = the preceding; (अम्), n. bark, rind.

चोलकिन्, ई, m. a cuirassier, a soldier armed with a
breastplate; the shoot of a bamboo; the orange
tree; the wrist.
